cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow my ladder for your shadow until Friday. Don't offer me cash; I taught you to bargain with what the other person wants.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've finally named a limit instead of apologising. Keep its office hours; I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. You used to hand me every worry before climbing; this time it counts as payment. I'll keep it till you're down.

reason: Give the former pupil a relevant remembered habit or taught action that determines A bargain, definition, assignment or ritual. Preserve original causal offers and make B participation materially necessary.
